scan.takePhoto: Take a photo of the bill
scan.cameraDenied: PettyCash Plus needs the camera to photograph receipts. Allow it in Settings, or choose a photo instead.
scan.sampleNote: Sample reading: in the demo every receipt reads as this sample, and the photo stays on this phone.

edit.title: Edit photo
edit.hint: Drag the corners to fit the receipt, or inside the frame to move it. Pinch or double-tap to zoom.

profile.title: Profile
profile.twoFactorOff: Two-factor sign-in is off for your role
profile.appearance: Automatic follows your phone's light or dark setting.

review.final: {{reference}} is approved. Finance pays it next.

reports.shareDemo: In the live app this shares the report as PDF or Excel, from the same export as the web, and records it in the Audit Log.

period.title: Period
period.hint: Tap the first day, then the last day.

notice.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
notice.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

enroll.openHint: On this phone, this opens your authenticator app with CashFlow ready to add. Install the app first if you have not.
enroll.noApp: No authenticator app opened. Install one, or type the key below into it.
enroll.key: Or type this key into the app
enroll.code: Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows
enroll.codesHint: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe: they are not shown again.

live.twoFactorOff: Two-factor sign-in is not set up

claim.noEmployee: This account is not linked to an employee, so it cannot claim expenses.
claim.checkEach: Check each value against the receipt. Values under {{min}}% sure are highlighted.
claim.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB. Choose a smaller one.

live.refused: The server could not accept this. Check the details and try again.

report.noShare: Sharing is not available on this device.

live.offline: Cannot reach the server. What you see was loaded earlier and may be out of date.

lock.title: Welcome back, {{name}}
lock.hint: Unlock with Face ID, your fingerprint or your phone's passcode.
